# GoLocal
> Local-service tools for personal agents. Public demo uses fictional providers.

## Files in this design prototype
- [Overview](README.md): connection and workflow
- [Agent instructions](SKILL.md): tool sequence and limits
- [MCP configuration](mcp-config.json): endpoint and transport
- [Capabilities](capabilities.json): tools and boundaries

## Existing public setup
- https://getgolocal.com/connectors
- https://getgolocal.com/demo/mcp

The files above are a proposed agent entry surface in this mockup,
not newly deployed files at getgolocal.com.
